> * If it's an independant search. Having independant searches seems fine.

Yes it's fine.

> * If if you want to sync the main results and the autocomplete results but with different indices, the idea to have an option for "not the main index" seems to solve it

We can also go in the other directions, do not assume that the autocomplete will be on the main index. WDYT? I'm still fine with the current proposal, it's just that I didn't think about it before.

> * If you have the main index + others and everything is synced, it's the default case

Yes indeed, depends on your answers on the question above.
